contract.intent: Report required-contract coverage gaps with adoption-mode severity while keeping checker orchestration free of coverage policy details.

must_not_change: Required-contract gaps must honor audit, warn, and enforce severities.
Extracted files must be preferred over rediscovering the whole source tree.

contract.intent: Report Drift SSOT usage violations through ESLint for contracts extracted from the file currently being linted.

must_not_change: The rule must only evaluate contracts extracted from the current file.
Every SSOT usage error must be forwarded through the shared reporter.
